To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a novel microfiber based Mach-Zehnder interferometer for ultrasensitive measurement of refractive index and temperature.

an in line microfiber M ZI can achieve a high temperature sensitivity and a high RI sensitivity around the DTP, and it is promising for ultrasensitive temperature measurement in fields with high precision requirement.

we have demonstrated an in line microfiber M ZI with a taper waist diameter of 4.8 μm for ultrasensitive liquid refractive index and temperature measurement by tuning the working wavelength around the DTP.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and fabrication of a microfiber MIZI with a high temperature sensitivity and a positive temperature sensitivity for temperature measurement applications.
the development of a microfiber MIZI for ultrasensitive liquid measurement by operating at both sides of the DPT.
the development of microfiber interferometers and their applications in RI and temperature measurements.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the microfiber based Mach-Zehnder interferometer can be used for ultrasensitive liquid RI and temperature measurement by tuning the operating wavelength at two sides of its dispersion turning point respectively.
a microfiber M Z I operating at two sides around DTP for liquid RI and temperature measurement is demonstrated.
an in line microfiber M ZI is demonstrated for ulrasensitive RI and temperature measurements by operating at two side of the dispersion turning points respectively.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the RI measurement and temperature sensing can be realized simultaneously in a single microfiber MZIsensor by operating at two different sides of the DPT.
the microfiber Mach Zender interferometer can be used to measure the refractive index and temperature of liquid analyte with high precision and small sample volume.
a microfiber MzI could work at two sides of a DTP for RI and temperature measurement, and this could be a new method to realize the simultaneous measurement of RI and temperature.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the RI sensitivity of a microfiber MIZ can be enhanced by operating at two different sides of the dispersion curve.
a microfiber MIZI could be used for both RI and temperature measurement if it is designed and fabricated at two sides of DTP.
the dispersion turning point is an important parameter for the design of microfiber MZIs for ultrasensitive liquid analytical measurement.
